description: [alias of cuba_sync] Git-friendly export/import of the knowledge graph between machines that share no database. export/import/diff/status work on a local directory, ./.memory-industry/ by default and otherwise as the dir parameter describes; pull/notify/fetch/conflicts/resolve talk to a peer over HTTP with CUBA_PEER_TOKEN.

action.description: export/import/diff/status: local bundle round-trip. pull: return the bundle in the response instead of writing it, for a peer to fetch. notify: tell a peer what changed. fetch: pull a peer's bundle over HTTP and import it. conflicts/resolve: list and settle rows two machines disagree about.

confirm.description: Required when the import's tombstones would delete more than 10% of this machine's observations and at least 25 rows

conflict.description: How to resolve a row that exists on both sides (default merge; merge and skip keep local content, overwrite takes the incoming version)

dir.description: Directory override. Without it: $CUBA_SYNC_DIR if set, else ./.memory-industry/ — or ./.cuba-memorys/ on a repo that already has that older directory

id.description: resolve only: the conflict id from action=conflicts

keep.description: resolve only: which text stays current (default 'both', which loses nothing)

limit.description: pull only: max files per page

manifest_hash.description: notify only: the bundle hash this notice refers to

node_id.description: notify only: self-asserted id of the sending node

node_name.description: notify only: readable name of the sending node

offset.description: pull only: index of the first bundle file to return

peer.description: fetch only: which peer to pull from (default 'default')

scope.description: Export scope: active project only (default) or all data

summary.description: notify only: what changed, in at most 2000 characters

url.description: fetch only: the peer's base address, e.g. https://brain.example.net

with_embeddings.description: Include embeddings (default false on export, true on pull)

name: memory_sync
